title: UnconnectedSend with nested attribute request and CPF interaction
purpose: Exercise nested Message Router forwarding, timeout fields, CPF item lengths, and an embedded GetAttributeSingle request in one distinct explicit-message structure.
expected_behavior: The server should parse the outer CPF, recognize the UnconnectedSend service and its embedded Message Router request, then return a bounded response or a deterministic protocol error without exceeding any declared item or message length.
constraints_preserved: CPF contains one null address item and one unconnected data item
outer data-item length equals the complete UnconnectedSend request
nested service and route fields are present within the declared item
all message hex strings have even length
issue_safety_notes: This covers issue 567 through safe CPF and nested-response structure variation. It does not copy the reported malformed item count, oversized attribute count, destination overflow, or historical crash bytes.
